name: Dylan's Game Informer
subtitle: A game magazine every day
description: A new issue every day, the same one as on the PC: the cover story is a Switch metroidvania (58 of them, from Hollow Knight to Nine Sols), with a big screenshot, why it's worth playing and the store's pitch.
Inside: a quirky indie game of the day, a big PS5 game on the way with a countdown to its release, and the next PS5 release dates.
features: A quirky indie game every day
Big PS5 games on the way, with a countdown
